items.caption:
Elon Musk says Starship will launch at least 300 gigawatts of AI compute a year.
He adds that 200 gigawatts a year alone would be a 40% annual increase in total US energy use, and it might one day reach a terawatt.
Source: RSBN, Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Tom Brown Discuss the AI Revolution. Full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=388P7IFSpwE

items.caption:
Jensen Huang says building 10 to 20 gigawatts of AI data centers a year creates probably about a million jobs.
The Nvidia CEO lists power plants, construction, cooling and pipe fitters, and calls it the first time in 50 years the US is reindustrializing.
Source: RSBN, Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Tom Brown Discuss the AI Revolution. Full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=388P7IFSpwE

items.caption:
Elon Musk says every 5 gigawatts of new steady power is a 1% increase in US power use, and he thinks it will mean about 1% more GDP.
On a Washington panel with Jensen Huang, he frames it against the roughly 500 gigawatts the US uses on average.
Source: RSBN, Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Tom Brown Discuss the AI Revolution. Full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=388P7IFSpwE
